exposure: low levels of physical activity in the third trimester
Physical activity levels during pregnancy (measured by trimester using the Pregnancy Physical Activity Questionnaire)
Women in the third trimester who performed low levels of physical activity
Mode of delivery (normal spontaneous delivery vs. unplanned cesarean section)
cohort: 150 pregnant women receiving prenatal care at 29-40 weeks of gestation at a medical center in northern Taiwan
finding: Pregnant women who engaged in lower levels of physical activity during their third trimester were more likely to undergo unplanned cesarean sections.
mod_finding: Women in the third trimester who performed low levels of physical activity had a higher odds ratio of undergoing a cesarean section.
